m2_definition.definition: A current rights-cleared Iraq Post assignment release, complete for its explicitly declared source and jurisdiction scope, preserves five-digit strings, postal-object and delivery types, validity and transition status; reproducible conversion and full-data validation feed immutable digest-pinned published data verified through the AGID loader/API. Any geometry or civic-address/building relation has independent authority, rights, temporal scope and lineage; no polygon, universal coverage or territorial authority is presumed.

definition_basis: The IQ manifest previously had no named M2 stage. This criterion formalizes its existing assignment, non-area, migration, privacy, jurisdiction and separate geometry/building rules. All nine hard blockers and the M1_metadata stage remain unchanged. A scoped release must not be described as national coverage.

nogp.scope: Public approved catalogue metadata only; search terms are not exhaustive and empty results do not prove national data absence. API-wide CC BY 4.0 requires attribution and exact-file licence-document review before redistribution; no current postal dataset was obtained.
nogp.transport: HTTPS only. On this Windows host Node's certificate chain validation fails for NOGP; the optional --windows-tls adapter uses normal Windows/.NET certificate validation without disabling TLS checks. API-advertised HTTP links are recorded only as diagnostics, never followed.

quality_rules: M2 grain is source-edition/jurisdiction/postal-object/validity assignment, not the postcode alone; one code may identify non-area or multiple delivery objects. Leading zeroes and digit identity remain strings.

For real assignments, measure missing codes/types/validity, composite-key duplicates, syntax validity, coverage and source-to-output counts. Without assignment rows these rates are null, never 0% errors.
Profile exact catalogue envelope, pagination, counts, licence declaration and item identity. Catalogue totals, item modification dates and HTTP Last-Modified are not assignment coverage or validity.

Never follow catalogue next/download URLs, ArcGIS item data/resources/layers, app accounts or private operational services. Do not persist source bodies, addresses, recipients, contact details, credentials or geometry.
Empty licence metadata is neither a grant nor a categorical ban; exact planned-use rights and current official authorship must be reviewed independently.
Only official postal artifacts can establish official geometry. Derived, virtual and none remain separate; no model, containment or nearest-building inference creates a civic or building relation.
